phases.title: Version 2.0 - Core Scraping API
phases.description: Establish a robust, configuration-driven system for data collection.

tasks.title: Implement Flexible Scraping Engine
tasks.description: Create the core `crawlConcertVenue` service using Firecrawl, supporting multiple extraction modes.

tasks.title: Build Unified API Endpoint
tasks.description: Develop the `POST /api/scrape` route to handle all scraping requests.

tasks.title: Set Up Data Persistence
tasks.description: Ensure scraped data saves correctly to JSON files and optionally to a Supabase `events` table with standardized format and UI import capabilities.
enhancements: Implemented standardized JSON format for consistency
Added direct JSON-to-Supabase import via API
Built user-friendly file upload interface for imports
Added comprehensive documentation for import features

tasks.title: Define Configuration Types
tasks.description: Create TypeScript types for `CrawlConfig` and `StorageOptions` in `types/scraping.d.ts`.

phases.title: Version 2.5 - User Accounts & Personalization
phases.description: Build the foundational layer for user-specific data and interactions.

tasks.title: Set Up Supabase Authentication
tasks.description: Implement user login, logout, and profile management using Supabase Auth.

tasks.title: Create User Profiles Table
tasks.description: Design and create the `profiles` table with a foreign key to `auth.users`.

tasks.title: Implement Hometown Feature
tasks.description: Allow users to set and update their hometown in their profile.

tasks.title: Create Core Data Tables
tasks.description: Design and implement the `venues` and `artists` tables in Supabase.

phases.title: Version 3.0 - Venue & Artist Following
phases.description: Connect users to the data that matters most to them.

tasks.title: Implement Venue Following Logic
tasks.description: Create the `followed_venues` table and the backend logic to follow/unfollow venues.

tasks.title: Implement Artist Following Logic
tasks.description: Create the `followed_artists` table and the backend logic to follow/unfollow artists.

tasks.title: Build 'My Profile' Dashboard
tasks.description: Create a UI where users can view and manage their followed artists and venues.

phases.title: Version 3.5 - The Personalized Feed
phases.description: Deliver the core value proposition of the app: a personalized concert feed.

tasks.title: Develop Personalized Feed Logic
tasks.description: Write the Supabase query to fetch events based on a user's followed artists and venues.

tasks.title: Build the Feed UI
tasks.description: Create the React components to display the upcoming shows in a clean, chronological list.

tasks.title: Implement Empty State UI
tasks.description: Design a component that guides new users to follow artists/venues if their feed is empty.

phases.title: Version 4.0 - Notifications & Discovery
phases.description: Enhance user engagement with notifications and music discovery features.

tasks.title: Set Up Email Notifications with SendGrid
tasks.description: Implement a Supabase Edge Function to send transactional emails (e.g., new show notifications) via the SendGrid API.

tasks.title: Develop Artist Discovery Algorithm
tasks.description: Create a simple recommendation engine to suggest new artists to users.

phases.title: Version 4.5 - Community & Content Management
phases.description: Empower users to contribute content and establish a robust moderation workflow.

tasks.title: Foundational Setup
tasks.description: Lay the groundwork for all community and admin features.

subtasks.title: Design & Document Features
subtasks.description: Create docs for community features, user roles, and moderation.

subtasks.title: Implement Config-Driven CRUD
subtasks.description: Create crud-config.json and the automated scaffolding script to manage and generate CRUD interfaces.

subtasks.title: Create Database Migrations
subtasks.description: Create tables for submitted_artists, submitted_venues, and user_roles, and update the venues table.

tasks.title: User Content Submission
tasks.description: Build the forms and APIs for users to submit new content.

subtasks.title: Create Artist Submission Form
subtasks.description: Build the UI at /artists/submit and the API endpoint to save data to the submitted_artists table.

subtasks.title: Create Venue Submission Form
subtasks.description: Build the UI at /venues/submit and the API endpoint to save data to the submitted_venues table.

tasks.title: Admin Moderation Interface
tasks.description: Develop the admin-only screens for reviewing submitted content.

subtasks.title: Create Secure Admin Layout
subtasks.description: Build a wrapper component that checks for the 'admin' role before rendering its children.

subtasks.title: Build 'Submitted Artists' Review Page
subtasks.description: Create an admin page to list all artists with a 'pending_review' status.

subtasks.title: Build 'Submitted Venues' Review Page
subtasks.description: Create an admin page to list all venues with a 'pending_review' status.

tasks.title: Admin Moderation Logic
tasks.description: Implement the backend logic for approving and rejecting submissions.

subtasks.title: Implement Artist Approval/Rejection
subtasks.description: Create the server-side logic to move an artist from 'submitted_artists' to 'artists' or mark it as rejected.

subtasks.title: Implement Venue Approval/Rejection
subtasks.description: Create the server-side logic to move a venue from 'submitted_venues' to 'venues' or mark it as rejected.
